svg.title: Toonverse wireframe 09: Discover & Reader
svg.text: Low-fidelity wireframe, not a final UI design · Toonverse Task 011 (0.11) · Desktop-first (Issue #17 D5)
Text cards: title, creator, latest episode, episode count. 12 per page (Issue #10 S11).
A baker who can only open her shop
Published episodes only, in number order.
Guests pressing Favorite get a sign-in prompt.
Images load lazily, full width up to 800 px.
Previous is disabled on the first episode.
Logged-in users only; newest favorite first.
Series without a published episode are not listed.
States: loading, empty, error, load more
Drafts and unpublished episodes return 404 on public
Reader images fill the screen width (up to
800 px); Previous and Next become a sticky
The Reader works for guests at phone width
Public pages show published episodes only (D8).
Guests can use Discover and the Reader (D1).
Discover paging: 12 per page with Load more
